description: This file contains Flutter widget classes that render a line chart for expense data over weeks, using custom painting and widgets. It defines the ExpenseLineChart widget, a helper widget for axis labels, and a custom painter for drawing the chart lines and fill.

classes.name: ExpenseLineChart
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that displays a simple line chart for weekly expense points.

classes.name: _XAxisLabels
classes.description: A private StatelessWidget that renders week labels along the X-axis.

classes.name: _LinePainter
classes.description: A CustomPainter class responsible for drawing the expense line chart, fill, points, and grid.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Build method for each widget class, defining the widget tree and drawing logic.
